default.description: What the island window may call: events, every feature, settings (read, and write for plugins that remember choices), and the third-party plugins to load.

overlay.description: The capture overlay: read the capture, copy or save the annotated image, hide itself.

popup.description: The shortcut popup: read settings and clipboard history, copy, paste, hide itself.

settings.description: The settings window: read and write settings, toggle launch at login, try shortcuts, list or open the third-party plugins folder, browse and install from the community store, and check for and install updates.
